notes: The scenario uses the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 subscribeObjectClassAttributes service with the adapter FOM's complete ordinary attribute set and active=false, then verifies the standard MIM report. The standard C++ API has no separate subscribeObjectClass service. The provider, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, attribute names, and update-rate designator are adapter-supplied.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes, bool active = true, std::wstring const & updateRateDesignator = L"") = 0
